Typically that means 4 to 8 years of experience building and running production data pipelines in a cloud environment. Strong Python and SQL. Experience with streaming or event-driven data, and with at least one modern data platform such as Databricks or Snowflake. Ability to own a pipeline or data domain end to end, make sound trade-offs between speed, cost, and reliability, and work independently with client technical teams. Clear written and verbal communication. Interest in sports; prior experience with competition, scoring, tracking, or sensor data is a plus. Consulting or client-facing experience preferred. Preferred: cloud data certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP); experience with computer vision, tracking, or sensor data. Additional Information We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way. Alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous PTO, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs. CapFlex – Employee-first mentality that supports a remote and hybrid workforce and empowers daily flexibility while servicing our clients Learning & Development – Programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths Modern Health –A mental health and well-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs Carrot Fertility –Inclusive fertility and family-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer-sponsored funds to help pay for care Fringe –A company paid stipend program for personalized lifestyle benefits, allowing employees to choose benefits that matter most to them – ranging from vendors like Netflix, Spotify, and GrubHub to services like student loan repayment, travel, fitness, and more Employee Resource Groups – Employee-led committees that embrace and incorporate diversity and inclusion into our day-to-day operations Philanthropic Partnerships – Opportunities to engage in partnerships and pro-bono projects that support our communities. 401(k) Matching – Generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness CapTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culture of equality, inclusion and fairness — each foundational to our core values. items.description: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. We are guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute, including deep customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in small, highly skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re building a globally diverse team of technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, value collaboration, and approach every challenge with a Day 1 mindset, with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you’re driven by continuous learning, rapid iteration, and the challenge of building in a high-growth startup, this is more than a role—it’s a journey. We’re seeking a Director of Security and Privacy Assurance to join our security organization. This is not a policy-and-paperwork GRC role. You’ll be the person who can sit in a room with a customer’s security team, walk through our architecture, and explain how we handle prompt injection and data boundaries. You’ll lead a small team of GRC and privacy engineers, own our certifications and third-party risk programs, and build the systems that let us scale assurance with AI automation. What you’ll own Customer-facing security assurance Serve as a key security expert to customers, prospects, auditors, and partners, leading security reviews and technical deep-dives Own customer security diligence: questionnaires, trust materials, and the trust center Join strategic sales conversations to speak credibly about our security program, product security, and AI security architecture Compliance and certifications Own our compliance programs end to end: SOC 2, PCI, HITRUST, ISO 42001, and HIPAA readiness Lead your team to run audit readiness and evidence collection, access reviews, and control testing, and drive findings to closure Maintain security policies, runbooks, and internal control documentation Third-party and enterprise risk Own the vendor risk program, including assessments, ongoing monitoring, and model and AI vendor review Run enterprise risk management and maintain risk dashboard AI governance and privacy engineering Build and operate AI governance frameworks covering data flows, model and vendor risk, prompt injection, jailbreaks, evals, logging, retention, and customer data boundaries Lead privacy engineering and privacy by design Support security and privacy incident response: customer and regulatory notification obligations, contractual breach timelines, and post-incident customer communication Strong partner to engineering and legal Partner with Legal on security, privacy, and AI terms in MSAs, DPAs, and SCCs. Own RFP security exceptions and customer-specific commitments Translate compliance and customer requirements into concrete technical controls and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on What you’ll need 9+ years of experience across security, compliance, or infrastructure security, including 4+ years leading and mentoring others Experience owning or materially operating SOC 2, PCI, and ISO programs Knowledge of the HIPAA Security Rule and experience with HITRUST Strong understanding of AI architecture and LLM security, including data boundaries, model and vendor risk, and emerging enterprise trust expectations Working knowledge of AWS security controls from a compliance perspective Experience building and managing vendor risk assessment programs Fluency with AI productivity tools and a track record of using AI to automate manual work Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can explain risk clearly to executives and speak engineers’ language without compliance jargon Experience reviewing code and system configurations; programming skills are a plus, not required Hands-on experience with GRC automation platforms like Drata Background in privacy engineering or familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and related regimes Experience at a high-growth startup or in a company that sells to enterprise customers Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, or similar technical degree $220,000 - $250,000 a year The actual salary may be different depending upon non-discriminatory factors such as qualifications, experience, and other factors permitted by law. ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance. #LI-AG1 #LI-Hybrid We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.title: PhD Scientist — STEM Expert
items.summary: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point.
items.description: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point. We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. How the selection process works Apply and complete the screening questions Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client Profile review Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up Originally posted on Himalayas

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering with hands-on experience in various tools and technologies. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines to ensure reliable data flows across the organization. Requirements: 4.5+ years of experience in a data engineering role Proficiency in AWS RDS and Snowflake for database management Hands-on experience with Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect Experience with Looker Familiarity with Datadog for monitoring and performance optimization English level - B2 Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously Responsibilities : Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using tools such as Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect. Manage and administer databases on AWS RDS and Snowflake to ensure optimal performance and data integrity. Design and implement data models and ETL processes to support business intelligence and analytics. Work with Looker to create and maintain insightful reports and dashboards. Monitor and optimize data workflows and performance using Datadog. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance with industry standards and best practices. Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues and provide ongoing support to data users across the organization. What we offer: Remote job with the freedom to work from anywhere in the world. Flexible work schedule tailored to your life and work needs. Competitive and timely salary. Opportunities for professional growth and development. The chance to gain experience in various fields and participate in exciting projects. Your ideas and initiatives are always welcome and valued. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS These aren't required, but will help you stand out: Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell. Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom) Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google) Comfort making short-form video Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.) Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. Life at ChiroCat ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do. HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify. Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone. Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience. You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often. And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. What You'll Do at ChiroCat At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true. Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves. This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team. A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE: Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!) Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy. Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan. Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.” Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise) You’re the right fit if: You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end. Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless. You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger. You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it. You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better. You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you. You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts. You love learning complex things. Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand. You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess. You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow. Ready to Apply? Apply (here: https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr ) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026. TWO IMPORTANT NOTES: We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers. We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute. WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE): Your resume A cover letter (Yep, we read them!) Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing). Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?” PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

items.description: Design Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. A ll email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain . We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments . If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@ 6sense.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/6sense-business-solutions-partner-enterprise-ai

Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-data-analytics-engineer-r14153

Your career progression is merit-based; the more you learn, take initiative, and consistently deliver quality work, the faster you can level up. Become Your Best: Set personal & professional goals every quarter with your talent coach. Get optional counselling along the way. Global Impact: Build products that reach users worldwide and truly make a difference in the world! Public Recognition: Track your achievements as you build a personalportfolio & track record. Join a Culture of Drivers : Become part of a team that’s striving to be their very best. Monthly salary ranges from AUD 420–600 , depending on hiring region, experience, and local market benchmarks. If this resonates with you, please apply today. P.S. We're hiring multiple individuals. If you want to recommend someone, please email us; an attractive referral bonus awaits! P.P.S. If you have any questions, email us at Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC, Remote Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What’s the opportunity? The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small - to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. We’re now seeing strong demand for data scientists who can apply their expertise directly with our most strategic customers. As a Forward Deployed Data Scientist, you’ll embed with customers to build Enterprise-grade Fin deployments. You’ll play a pivotal role in transforming how our most strategic customers scale customer support — working closely with them and our go-to-market teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that unlock measurable impact. You’ll also feed insights from these frontline deployments back into Intercom’s product and strategy — helping shape the future of AI customer service. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, is energized by solving complex, real-world problems with data, and is motivated by seeing their work translate into both customer impact and product evolution. What will I be doing? Drive the adoption of Fin by helping customers automate and scale their support operations. Embed with strategic customers to understand their support workflows, data, and business challenges — to identify and implement opportunities where AI can deliver measurable impact. Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin. Partner closely with Sales, Success, and Product to deliver seamless customer experiences and successful deployments, and to create feedback loops that shape product development. Use AI to prototype, test, and scale data-driven solutions, building tools that make us faster and more effective in driving Fin adoption and customer impact. What skills do I need? Proven ability to apply data science in real-world business contexts to drive measurable outcomes. Strong collaboration mindset; skilled at working across Sales, Success, Product, and Engineering. High adaptability and ownership: able to shift between deep technical analysis and high-level strategic framing. Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical. Rapid prototyping with systems thinking: you know when a customer needs a fast, bespoke answer, and when to build something others will keep using. Excellent SQL and production-aware Python, you write code other people can run, not just code that runs once and are experienced applying analytical and statistical methods to real business problems. Experience with AI/ML evaluation, LLM-driven applications, or conversational AI. Willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build deep relationships and uncover insights firsthand. Bonus skills and attributes Experience in technical consulting, customer-facing analytics, or SaaS product data science. Experience reframing the problem, not just solving it, you've spotted when the question you were handed wasn't the right one, and changed what got worked on. Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow. *Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the New York Area is $206,000- $229,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). #LI-Hybrid Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Policies Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values . Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-senior-forward-deployed-data-scientist

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote, United States JOB OVERVIEW The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, United States JOB OVERVIEW The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount. The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Own deal structuring for complex new business, expansion, and renewal deals, partnering with sales leaders on creative structures that protect margin and policy. Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy. Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones. Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff. Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook. Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development. Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail. Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds. Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation. Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions. Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field. REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS companies, including 3+ years owning Deal Desk operations end to end. Demonstrated experience building Deal Desk processes from the ground up at an early-stage or growth-stage company, with the ability to walk through what was built, in what order, and what you would do differently. Hands-on AI practitioner who has used AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce) to automate real Deal Desk or RevOps work, with an example to share. Hands-on experience structuring and contracting international SaaS deals across multiple regions, currencies, and legal entities. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term. As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment. We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. What the work looks like for our data team: Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement Serve as technical partner to program teams Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies Load-test our systems to prepare for elections Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar. This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. Responsibilities Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations Strong proficiency in SQL and Python Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar Nice to Have: Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters Experience on Google Cloud Platform Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply. Base salary of $90,000-$150,000 Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off Remote first culture with teammates all around the country. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible. Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time. Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com. Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/movement-labs-senior-data-engineers
