We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes. Working Within Our Values: At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required. Your focus of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes. Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation. Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. Qualifications You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others). You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level. You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals. You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables. You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process. Competitive Total Compensation Package At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more! The Use of Artificial Intelligence Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent. Hiring Eligibility by Location While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship. Beware of Hiring Scams Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse). Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thrive-digital-performance-strategist-demand-gen-performance-marketing-el-salvador

Sunday-to-Thursday (including Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, and Thur), 9AM-to-5PM. This is an exciting opportunity in our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department at Natera (a global leader in precision medicine and genomics testing), to provide critical data analytics support for our lab production operations. As a Senior Data Analyst for Lab Production Support in our DSPE Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) team, you will work in the Weekend Shift team (following the above two rotation schedules). You will have the opportunity to apply innovative data analytics solutions, directly support the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real & immediate impact to patients and healthcare providers, by providing timely & accurate data analysis support to Natera's production laboratories, as well as for other key business needs. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Technical Execution and Infrastructure Deliver timely data support to Lab Operations teams, unblock production issues, and improve patient results turnaround times. Apply statistical techniques to analyze complex datasets, diagnose operational issues, and support data-driven decision-making. Perform exploratory data analysis, identify trends, and work with stakeholders to interpret findings and drive continuous improvement. Design and implement automated solutions for recurring data analysis and production support workflows, improving operational efficiency and scalability. Extract, transform, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support lab production operations and business decisions. Document analytical processes, best practices, and insights to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer across teams. Process Improvement Develop and optimize solutions for efficient data retrieval and scalable performance on large and/or complex datasets. Learn and acquire operational efficiencies on new technologies and solutions developed by other DSPE teams. Train and coach junior team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Lab Operations and Product teams to identify process issues, assist with root cause analysis, and provide product support. Represent the Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) team in stakeholder meetings. Effectively and correctly escalate encountered issues to other DSPE teams. QUALIFICATIONS: Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Operational Research, or other related fields. Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience. Minimum 3 years of experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings). Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, extraction, querying in production support roles. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories. Knowledge of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and/or bioinformatics is a plus. Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques. Proficient in Python and SQL development. Working knowledge of Snowflake platform and cloud technologies. Strong understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, central limit theorem, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and regression modeling. Good documentation practices and coding style. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong integrity. The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Remote USA $113,600 — $142,000 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. items.title: Software Engineer - App Stores
items.summary: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany (Remote) Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Growth based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Outbound prospecting into net-new customers Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & German Bonus Points For: Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Rewards In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-commercial-account-executive-growth-remote-germany

items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. items.description: Product Headquarters: Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-it-engineer

items.description: About Pacaso Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We’ve reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle. Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We’ve raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding , closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing. Our work has been featured in The New York Times , The Wall Street Journal , Fortune , Forbes , CNBC , Bloomberg , and others. Recognition We’re a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work: No. 5, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025) Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024) Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023) LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022) In-House Counsel, Securities & Generalist About the role Pacaso is hiring an In-House Counsel to lead our SEC reporting and securities compliance, and to be a trusted generalist partner across the business. You will own the legal side of our periodic filings and disclosure process. You will also support the business on a wide range of other legal matters as they come up. Roughly half your time will go to securities and governance. The other half will be whatever the business needs, from commercial agreements and real estate to employment, marketing and privacy. This role suits a lawyer with 3 to 5+ years of law firm or in-house experience in securities or capital markets work who now wants breadth, direct business impact and a seat close to decision-makers. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations and executive leadership. What you’ll do SEC reporting and securities Own the preparation and review of the company’s SEC filings, including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and offering materials. Lead the disclosure process with Finance and Accounting. Advise on securities law compliance, including offerings, equity issuances and insider trading. Stay current on SEC rules and guidance, and update policies and processes as needed. Public company governance and compliance Serve as a primary legal advisor on the company’s obligations as an SEC reporting company. Support the board and its committees, including meeting materials, minutes and written consents. Maintain governance documents and company policies. Partner with Finance on disclosure controls and related processes. Maintain entity records and good standing across subsidiaries. Business and general legal support You will be a true generalist and a day-to-day legal partner to teams across the company, from the front line to the executive team. We need someone who is excited by variety, comfortable learning new areas quickly, and ready to build legal processes as the company grows. Draft, negotiate and manage agreements, including vendor, partnership, technology and services contracts. Support real estate and property-related matters, including entity structuring, transactions and state-by-state regulatory questions. Partner with People on employment matters such as policies, offer and separation agreements, leave and accommodation questions, and wage-and-hour compliance. Advise Marketing and Sales on advertising, promotions, disclosures and licensing requirements. Support privacy and data protection, including policies, vendor data processing agreements and responses to individual requests. Help manage intellectual property, including trademarks, brand protection and software licensing. Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, disputes and regulatory inquiries, and manage their budgets and scope. Build scalable legal processes, such as contract templates, intake and approval workflows and playbooks, so the business can move faster with fewer one-off requests. What you bring Required J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing. 3 to 5+ years of experience at a well-regarded law firm or in-house legal team, with substantial securities or capital markets work. Hands-on experience drafting or reviewing SEC periodic reports and disclosure documents. Working knowledge of federal securities laws and SEC reporting requirements. Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, at a law firm or in-house. Ability to learn unfamiliar areas of law quickly, and to recognize when to escalate or engage outside counsel. Sound judgment, clear writing, and the ability to explain legal risk in plain terms to non-lawyers. Comfort managing many matters at once with limited supervision. Preferred In-house or secondment experience at a startup or high-growth company. Exposure to real estate, employment, privacy or intellectual property matters. Experience building templates, playbooks or legal operations processes. Comfort working with non-legal teams as a day-to-day business partner. Compensation Around $190,000- we will consider experience and location as variables RSU grant Why You’ll Love Working Here We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care. Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we’re building Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare 401(k) to help you build long-term security Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment Our Commitment Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we’re committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

items.description: Company Description Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries. Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. Job Description Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Estimator / Cost Manager to serve as the primary day-to-day client interface on large, mission-critical construction programs within the US Electric Vehicle (EV) and transportation infrastructure sector. You will provide commercial leadership during design and construction, supporting the delivery of complex EV facilities and depots featuring infrastructure-heavy works, MEP-intensive buildings, and fleet-charging systems. The ideal candidate is highly organized, confident in client-facing environments, and able to work independently within integrated project teams while upholding Turner & Townsend’s standards for commercial governance. This role offers US remote flexibility, though proximity to the SF Bay Area for local stakeholder engagement is a strong advantage. Responsibilities: Act as the primary day-to-day commercial interface with the client during design and construction. Provide cost planning, estimating, and forecasting services, including producing and presenting cost plans at key design and construction milestones. Establish and maintain robust cost control, change management, and commercial governance processes. Estimate, review, negotiate, and manage change orders throughout the construction lifecycle. Review contractor and subcontractor pricing for accuracy, entitlement, and value for money, leading negotiations on behalf of the client where required. Manage contingency, commitment tracking, cost-to-complete forecasting, and cost variance analysis. Perform post-contract quantity surveying, cost control, valuations, and payment certification. Carry out accurate interim valuations, cost checks, and commercial audits on medium to large construction projects. Review and provide written commentary on contractor submissions, including executive summaries. Administer cost and commercial aspects of contracts, supporting correct application of contractual mechanisms. Ensure final accounts are negotiated, agreed, and closed out in a timely and defensible manner. Compile built-cost data and benchmarking records to support future phases and portfolio planning. Collaborate with owners, project managers, design teams, and contractors to support cost development and design progression. Inform and influence engineering and design priorities by assessing and communicating cost, risk, and schedule impacts. Coordinate all sources of cost data, including GC submissions, subcontractor pricing, supplier inputs, direct procurement, and quantities from A/Es. Participate in value engineering and design optioneering exercises, supporting cost optimization without compromising performance or schedule. Prepare funding data, executive cost presentations, and reporting materials for stakeholder review. Support commercial management of infrastructure-intensive and operationally critical systems, including: Electrical distribution and utility upgrades MEP-heavy building systems Site works, civil packages, and phased construction EV charging and fleet-support infrastructure integrated into facility environments Manage cost and change implications associated with phased delivery, fast-track construction, and evolving operational requirements. Produce accurate monthly cost reports, forecasts, and commercial dashboards for client presentation. Utilize internal systems to manage commission financial performance, margins, and resource forecasting. Implement and maintain Turner & Townsend Business Management Systems and delivery methodologies. Identify, coach, and mentor junior staff, supporting professional development and technical excellence. Act as a role model for collaboration, integrity, and consistent service delivery. SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or a related construction discipline. Proven experience in the Electric Vehicle (EV) sector is required, specifically involving EV charging infrastructure, fleet facilities, or related industrial developments. A minimum of 6-7+ years of relevant experience in a cost management or quantity surveying role within the US construction industry. Proven experience delivering cost management services on medium to large, complex construction projects within transportation, industrial, infrastructure, or mission-critical environments. Background in construction consultancy or client-side cost management strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of US construction contracts, procurement routes, valuations, change control, and final account processes. Experience supporting MEP-intensive works, infrastructure packages, and utility-driven construction scope. RICS accreditation or progress toward chartership preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with confidence engaging senior stakeholders. Additional Information *On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client’s needs. The base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change. We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community. Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com and www.heery.com All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects: Twitter Instagram LinkedIn _It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time._ Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorised Recruitment Agency/Search Firm for Turner & Townsend, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by the Recruitment Team, to submit candidates for review.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. Job Description Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Estimator / Cost Manager to serve as the primary day-to-day client interface on large, mission-critical construction programs within the US Electric Vehicle (EV) and transportation infrastructure sector. You will deliver disciplined commercial and cost management services during design and construction, supporting the delivery of complex EV facilities and depots featuring infrastructure-heavy works, MEP-intensive buildings, and fleet-charging systems. The ideal candidate is highly organized, confident in client-facing environments, and able to work independently within integrated project teams while upholding Turner & Townsend’s standards for commercial governance. This role offers US remote flexibility, though proximity to the SF Bay Area for local stakeholder engagement is a strong advantage. Responsibilities: Act as the primary day-to-day commercial interface with the client during design and construction. Provide cost planning, estimating, and forecasting services, including producing and presenting cost plans at key design and construction milestones. Establish and maintain robust cost control, change management, and commercial governance processes. Estimate, review, negotiate, and manage change orders throughout the construction lifecycle. Review contractor and subcontractor pricing for accuracy, entitlement, and value for money, leading negotiations on behalf of the client where required. Manage contingency, commitment tracking, cost-to-complete forecasting, and cost variance analysis. Perform post-contract quantity surveying, cost control, valuations, and payment certification. Carry out accurate interim valuations, cost checks, and commercial audits on medium to large construction projects. Review and provide written commentary on contractor submissions, including executive summaries. Administer cost and commercial aspects of contracts, supporting correct application of contractual mechanisms. Ensure final accounts are negotiated, agreed, and closed out in a timely and defensible manner. Compile built-cost data and benchmarking records to support future phases and portfolio planning. Collaborate with owners, project managers, design teams, and contractors to support cost development and design progression. Inform and influence engineering and design priorities by assessing and communicating cost, risk, and schedule impacts. Coordinate all sources of cost data, including GC submissions, subcontractor pricing, supplier inputs, direct procurement, and quantities from A/Es. Participate in value engineering and design optioneering exercises, supporting cost optimization without compromising performance or schedule. Prepare funding data, executive cost presentations, and reporting materials for stakeholder review. Support commercial management of infrastructure-intensive and operationally critical systems, including: Electrical distribution and utility upgrades MEP-heavy building systems Site works, civil packages, and phased construction EV charging and fleet-support infrastructure integrated into facility environments Manage cost and change implications associated with phased delivery, fast-track construction, and evolving operational requirements. Produce accurate monthly cost reports, forecasts, and commercial dashboards for client presentation. Utilize internal systems to manage commission financial performance, margins, and resource forecasting. Implement and maintain Turner & Townsend Business Management Systems and delivery methodologies. Identify, coach, and mentor junior staff, supporting professional development and technical excellence. Act as a role model for collaboration, integrity, and consistent service delivery. SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or a related construction discipline. Proven experience in the Electric Vehicle (EV) sector is required, specifically involving EV charging infrastructure, fleet facilities, or related industrial developments. 5+ years of relevant experience in a cost management or quantity surveying role within the US construction industry. Proven experience delivering cost management services on medium to large, complex construction projects within transportation, industrial, infrastructure, or mission-critical environments. Background in construction consultancy or client-side cost management strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of US construction contracts, procurement routes, valuations, change control, and final account processes. Experience supporting MEP-intensive works, infrastructure packages, and utility-driven construction scope. RICS accreditation or progress toward chartership preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with confidence engaging senior stakeholders. Additional Information *On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client’s needs. The base salary range for this role is $130K-$150K. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change. We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community. Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/ All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects: Twitter Instagram LinkedIn _It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time._ Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: UNITED STATES - Remote, LATAM - Remote, EMEA - Remote Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About the role This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current. Responsibilities Planning Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register. Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead. Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation. Execution Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit. Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current. Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires. Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts. Tracking and evaluating performance Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force. Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view. Achieving overall defined performance Be accountable for a current, defensible posture engine — register, evidence and audit operations. Ensure Drata collects evidence continuously, with automated evidence where coverage exists. Qualifications Hands-on experience running a risk register, control library and audit cycle (ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2). Comfortable with GRC platforms (Drata or equivalent) and turning monitoring into evidence. Proven ability to coordinate audits and customer questionnaires with named control owners. Precise written work; register and Statement of Applicability quality matters. Strong stakeholder management with control owners and auditors. CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, or equivalent professional certification. Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role . The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range. US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits) $150,000 — $206,000 USD In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page. MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metamask-risk-controls-manager

By integrating directly with leading Patient Management Systems, their software provides branded, web-based patient intake forms and dedicated check-in kiosk solutions that streamline clinical operations and enhance the patient journey. Backed by an established strategic roadmap and marketing leadership, the organization is scaling its multi-channel footprint and market reach. ROLE OVERVIEW: Working directly alongside the Marketing Growth Lead, the Marketing Specialist acts as the core tactical execution engine for the brand. This role bridges high-level strategy and day-to-day operations by managing content output, web pages, email nurture sequences, and multi-channel campaigns. It is designed for an autonomous, execution-focused professional who excels at turning strategic roadmaps into measurable pipeline momentum in a fully remote setup. RESPONSIBILITIES: Content Production: Write, edit, and publish blog posts, resources, and case studies that speak to Allied Health clinic owners and practice managers. Manage the content calendar and maintain a consistent publishing cadence. Website & Landing Pages: Build and update pages in Webflow — including landing pages, feature pages, and conversion-focused content — to support campaigns and improve the buyer journey. Email Marketing: Set up and execute email campaigns including nurture sequences, onboarding flows, and re-engagement campaigns using our email marketing platform. Campaign Execution: Deploy and monitor marketing campaigns across B2B channels, including paid acquisition when required. Social Media: Maintain a consistent, high-quality presence across relevant social platforms. Plan, create, and schedule posts that build awareness and drive traffic. Review & Reputation Campaigns: Drive customer review campaigns to build social proof on relevant platforms. Performance Tracking: Monitor campaign and channel performance, pull basic reporting, and flag what's working and what isn't. You don't need to be a data analyst, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards and reporting on key metrics. Momentum Building: Proactively identifying the next steps needed to keep our growth roadmap on track. What We're Looking For Execution Focus: You love the "doing" part of marketing and take pride in seeing a plan come to life. Eye for design: Good instincts for layout, imagery, and visual consistency. You can create professional-looking assets without needing a designer for every task. Self-Starters: You are proactive and comfortable working independently within a defined strategy. Reliability: You are a consistent "engine" who can be counted on to deliver high-quality work. Comfortable with marketing tools like Slack, Webflow, G2, Gartner, Plausible Analytics, Google ecosystem B2B Experience: Ideally some marketing experience in the B2B SaaS landscape. Highly Desirable Direct background or familiarity with the Allied Health, healthcare, or clinic management software industry. Tech-forward mindset with an appetite for adopting modern AI tools to augment workflows, accelerate output, and maintain high operational leverage. Prior experience managing multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-part-time-digital-marketing-specialist

How will you help us make an impact? Reporting to the VP of Professional Services, the Delivery Executive serves as Clariti’s senior strategic relationship leader, designated Executive Sponsor, and project P&L owner for our largest, most complex government customers. As a trusted executive advisor, you are accountable for account health, customer outcomes, financial performance, and long-term growth. You represent Clariti leadership in critical customer engagements, maintain executive alignment, resolve complex escalations, and balance customer commitments with Clariti’s commercial objectives. You hold full P&L accountability for assigned implementation projects and professional services engagements, overseeing revenue, delivery costs, gross margin, forecasting, and commercial risks. Engagement Managers retain day-to-day project execution responsibility; you provide executive accountability, strategic direction, and financial oversight. You collaborate with Professional Services Leadership, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Finance, and implementation partners to deliver complex government transformation programs and develop lasting customer relationships. As a Delivery Executive at Clariti, your role will encompass: Executive Sponsorship & Strategic Account Leadership Serve as Clariti’s designated Executive Sponsor for strategic government accounts valued at $20M+ in total contract value. Own executive-level account health, strategic alignment, critical escalations, and long-term relationship success. Develop multiyear account plans aligned to government priorities, implementation objectives, and growth opportunities. Build trusted relationships with CIO, city manager, agency heads, department directors, and other decision-makers. Represent Clariti in steering committees, strategic planning sessions, executive business reviews, and critical engagements. Understand customer organizational structures, procurement, budgets, political sensitivities, and technology roadmaps. Lead executive-level recovery and stabilization efforts when delivery performance or customer confidence deteriorates. Project P&L Ownership & Financial Accountability Own the P&L for the assigned implementation project, including revenue, delivery costs, gross margin, and profitability for the assigned project. Establish financial objectives and own revenue projections, cost-to-complete estimates, margin forecasts, and financial risk assessments. Partner with Engagement Managers, Professional Services Operations, and Finance to track actuals against budgets and forecasts. Identify and address financial risks from scope expansion, delays, staffing overruns, non-billable work, and partner performance. Drive corrective actions to recover margins and address revenue shortfalls without compromising contractual commitments. Oversee resource economics, utilization, staffing models, and partner costs in collaboration with delivery leadership. Ensure scope changes and additional requirements are commercially addressed through change requests, amendments, or services agreements. Monitor billing milestones and revenue recognition with Finance and provide clear project P&L reporting to leadership. Strategic Delivery Leadership & Governance Provide executive oversight for complex, high-visibility, high-risk government implementation programs. Partner with Engagement Managers to monitor schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, acceptance criteria, and contractual commitments. Establish governance, decision rights, escalation paths, and executive reporting cadences. Anticipate delivery risks and lead executive interventions, contingency planning, and corrective action strategies. Champion milestone-based forecasting, transparent financial reporting, and proactive risk management. Coordinate with PS leadership on staffing, capacity, utilization, delivery quality, and team sustainability. Oversee system integrator and implementation partner performance, holding stakeholders accountable for agreed outcomes. Support repeatable delivery frameworks and lessons learned while preserving EM ownership of daily execution. Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Management Act as trusted advisor to senior government leaders and build relationships before critical dependencies arise. Lead executive steering committees and connect program progress to measurable government outcomes. Communicate complex financial, technical, and delivery issues clearly to senior audiences. Anticipate stakeholder objections and navigate competing priorities across departments, consultants, and partners. Own executive-level escalation strategy and restore alignment through transparent, constructive communication. Maintain multi-level relationships across executive, operational, technical, and procurement stakeholders. Strategic Account Growth & Commercial Management Identify expansion opportunities across departments, agencies, product offerings, implementation phases, and services. Partner with Sales and Customer Success on renewals, contract extensions, retention, and expansion strategies. Assess opportunities for customer value, delivery feasibility, profitability, and long-term strategic fit. Support complex commercial negotiations with Sales, Finance, Legal, and PS leadership. Identify and advance change requests and additional services opportunities arising from evolving requirements. Develop executive advocates, reference customers, and long-term strategic partnerships. Delivery Excellence & Quality Champion measurable government outcomes such as reduced permitting time, faster intake, and improved service throughput. Ensure programs maintain quality controls, testing standards, acceptance criteria, and governance practices. Assess delivery performance through milestones, financial results, customer satisfaction, and outcomes. Support sustainable resource planning that balances utilization, quality, financial performance, and team health. items.description: About Decentralized Masters Decentralized Masters is an investment education and research company. We went from two co-founders to 160+ people and 4,500+ paying members in four years, bootstrapped and profitable. Our business is built on continuity: high-ticket and low-ticket programmes that are membership-based, with payment plans, renewals, upsells and a paid newsletter. We have never taken outside capital. Our growth is still heavily direct-response: paid media on Facebook, YouTube and Google feeds the webinars, calls and offers that fund everything we do. Our vision is to become the gold standard in investment education and research. The Role You own the strategy behind our paid ad creative. You turn audience insight and performance data into concepts, hooks, and briefs that creators and editors can execute, and you keep a steady pipeline of fresh, compliant ads that lower acquisition cost and scale spend. What You’ll Do Develop creative strategy for paid social and video channels (Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and others as we expand), grounded in audience research, customer language, and offer positioning. Generate high volumes of concepts, angles, hooks, and scripts across formats (UGC-style, talking head, motion, static, carousel). Write clear creative briefs for editors, designers, and creators, and review work against the brief. Run a structured creative testing framework: hypotheses, naming conventions, test cells, and readouts. Analyze ad performance (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPL, cost per booked call, downstream quality) and translate findings into the next round of concepts. Monitor competitors and the broader ad landscape; build a swipe file and a library of winning patterns. Mine sales calls, member feedback, and comments for pain points, objections, and language that become ad angles. Partner with the CRO Strategist to keep ad message and landing page message aligned. Work with the media buying team on creative needs by campaign, refresh cadence, and fatigue signals. Ensure every ad meets DM compliance standards and platform policies, especially around financial and investment claims. Report weekly on creative output, winners, losers, and learnings to the Director of Acquisition. What You Bring 3-5 years in creative strategy, performance creative, or paid social, ideally for direct-response, info-product, education, or high-ticket offers. A portfolio or track record of ads you conceived that scaled, with the metrics behind them. Strong direct-response copywriting and scriptwriting skills, especially for short-form video hooks. Fluency in Meta Ads Manager and creative analytics tools; comfortable reading performance data and drawing conclusions. Ability to brief and give sharp feedback to editors, designers, and creators. Solid understanding of platform ad policies and compliant claim-making. Curiosity about digital assets, gold, and stocks, or the ability to get up to speed quickly. Fast, organized, and comfortable with a high-volume testing cadence. You use AI tools in your daily workflow. Nice to Have Experience in investment education, fintech, or other regulated/claims-sensitive categories. Basic video editing or design skills (CapCut, Premiere, Canva, Figma). Experience with creative testing tools or dashboards (Motion, Triple Whale, Foreplay, etc.). Experience using AI to speed up ideation, scripting, and variation production. How Success Is Measured Number of winning creatives (ads that beat the control on cost per booked call). Creative testing velocity and hit rate. Lower cost per lead and cost per booked call over time. Creative freshness: no scaled campaign running on fatigued assets. Quality of briefs and turnaround time with the production team. Compliance record: zero preventable ad rejections or account flags. What We Offer Competitive base, depending on scale and experience. Full-time, 40 hours a week, with a flexible schedule and unlimited PTO. Entirely remote, working from anywhere in the world, with team off-sites. A supportive, dynamic culture with team members across 30+ countries.

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA- For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. The CritSit process will ensure a high level of customer satisfaction, retention and expansion resulting in both resolution of each customer’s challenges to a healthy state and of continuous improvement and institutional learning from each customer engagement to prevent recurrences across our install base. You’ll partner closely with GTM leadership of our Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, as well as Sales and Product leadership to build and define the CritSit process methodology and operating model. This role will regularly report out on the status of CritSit customers to our corporate leadership team. Not only will you be on the front line with many of Smartsheet’s largest customer relationships, but also those struggling with ambitious innovative solution plans intended to lead our install base forward. Your work will be global and highly cross-functional in nature. You will problem-solve alongside leaders in other teams such as Product, Support, Sales, and Finance, to drive resolution and elevate the customer experience. You will report to the VP of Customer Experience, Programs and Strategy. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered. Analyzes resolution path for high-stakes issues, and develops a strategy and gain alignment across executives for an effective and efficient solution. services teams Understanding of SaaS organizational and operational constructs including Product, engineering, support, success, sales, services Ability to quickly establish trust and to influence others, both internally and externally Ability to handle conflict and drive agreement on decisions for which conflicting opinions and input exist Strong data-driven decision making skills, and process oriented mindset Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement approaches Ability to identify risks and dependencies and put in place plans to mitigate them Adaptability, flexibility and
