manage parallel efforts, and communicate effectively through multiple channels Exceptional business acumen and world-class presentation and customer interaction skills that have been acquired through deep technical knowledge and well-developed process management Goal orientation to drive progress for each customer through each interaction Experience building, leading or teaming with teams similar to HyperCare at a mature technology company, optional but highly desired Experience with Smartsheet, Kibana, Snowflake, Tableau, Sparkpost, and Google Suite optional but highly desired Knowledge of the Smartsheet platform optional but highly desired Current US Perks & Benefits: Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees 401k Match to help you save for your You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. Please note this role is a full-time 6-month contract position. Can attract top talent across North America, utilizing creative outreach while also generating qualified inbound in partnership with the hiring team. As a Talent team, our goal is to find a strong mutual fit between candidates and Clariti, while delivering an exceptional hiring experience both to our candidates and our hiring teams. This role requires proven expertise in full-cycle recruitment across both technical and non-technical roles, a track record in partnering with hiring managers to build high-performing teams, and the ability to take a data-driven approach to understand the market, their candidate pool, and ultimately ensure hiring managers can make informed decisions. Beyond recruitment, the right person for our team is someone who understands how to leverage slower hiring periods to build leverage for the business. This includes proactively sourcing & building pipelines, talent mapping, increasing hiring manager & hiring team capabilities, driving process or data improvements, or collaborating across broader talent projects with the ability to demonstrate value-add and/or connect to relevant business outcomes As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at Clariti, you will: Collaborate with hiring managers at all levels to define & lead full-cycle recruitment over a given requisition load. This includes creating or refining job descriptions, defining outreach/sourcing strategies, building an equitable evaluation process, coordinating & assessing candidates, and conducting offer & negotiation conversations. Build and maintain partnerships with hiring managers to align search strategies with staffing goals while also building pipelines for future hiring needs. Educate hiring managers on the talent landscape through the use of internal and external insights to support informed decision-making that is data-driven. Keep HMs aligned on closing strategy, navigate counteroffers and competing offers, and drive decision-making forward when teams stall. Diagnose pipeline drop-off points and provide tailored solutions to improve conversion rate. Hands-on fluency with approved AI tools, including ability to exercise judgement, test & iterate, and demonstrating actual use cases in current recruitment practice and/or previous roles. Ability to identify process improvements through the use of AI related to increasing capacity & efficiency without sacrificing the hiring experience and ultimately ensuring all final decisions at each stage are made by a member of our hiring team. Demonstrating measurable impact and can show time saved, quality of output, or a change in funnel metrics, with the ability to knowledge share and improve our talent practice. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://impulseuniverse.com Benefits: Bonus based on performance Company parties Flexible schedule About the Event America’s largest Lunar New Year spectacle is back and bolder than ever! Spanning 7 massive halls with over 1,400 vendors, the Asian American Expo brings you the ultimate celebration of mouthwatering Asian street food, nonstop cultural performances, and high-energy excitement. Step into the Year of the Ram, grab your official Red Envelope at the door, and get ready to experience the luckiest weekend of the year! About the Role We are seeking a high-energy, results-obsessed Marketing Contractor to drive direct ticket sales for the Asian American Expo 2027, America’s largest Lunar New Year celebration (7 massive halls, 1,400+ vendors, and hourly cash Red Envelope prize drops taking place January 16–17, 2027 at the Fairplex in Pomona, CA). This is NOT a brand awareness or vanity metrics role. We are looking for a direct-response outreach strategist whose sole focus is converting Southern California local audiences into paying ticket holders through nano/micro-influencers and grassroots digital community channels. Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager

items.description: Popis společnosti Turner & Townsend je globální společnost poskytující profesionální služby s více než 22 000 zaměstnanci ve více než 60 zemích světa. Spolupracujeme s našimi klienty v oblasti nemovitostí, infrastruktury, energetiky a přírodních zdrojů a společně realizujeme projekty, které zlepšují kvalitu života lidí. Díky úzké spolupráci jsme schopni dodávat jedny z nejvýznamnějších projektů a programů na světě, přičemž proměňujeme výzvy v příležitosti a složitost v úspěch. Naše odborné služby zahrnují řízení programů a projektů, cost management, asset a commercial management, project controls a performance management, procurement a supply chain, strategie pro dosažení uhlíkové neutrality (Net Zero) a digitální řešení. Popis nabídky práce Na této pozici se budete věnovat technickému poradenství v oblasti komerčních nemovitostí. Vaším hlavním úkolem bude posuzování technického stavu budov, identifikace případných závad a rizik a doporučování vhodných řešení. Budete se podílet především na technických auditech nemovitostí (Technical Due Diligence) pro investory a nájemce, ale také na projektech rekonstrukcí, modernizací a technického zhodnocení budov. Co bude Vaší náplní práce? Provádění technických auditů komerčních nemovitostí (Technical Due Diligence) v rámci jejich nákupu, prodeje, pronájmu nebo financování. Posuzování technického stavu budov na základě dostupné projektové a technické dokumentace a osobních prohlídek nemovitostí. Kontrola stavebních konstrukcí, střech, fasád, obálky budov, požární bezpečnosti a souladu s platnými stavebními předpisy. Identifikace technických závad, rizik a nedostatků v údržbě, včetně návrhů vhodných nápravných opatření. Příprava odborných technických zpráv, doporučení a odhadů nákladů na potřebné opravy či rekonstrukce. Posuzování souladu nemovitostí s legislativními požadavky a zohledňování principů udržitelnosti. Spolupráce s českými i mezinárodními klienty, především v oblasti kancelářských, logistických, rezidenčních, obchodních a hotelových nemovitostí. Většina technických zpráv a dalších výstupů bude připravována v angličtině. Kvalifikace Máte vzdělání nebo odpovídající odbornou kvalifikaci v oblasti stavebnictví, architektury nebo technické správy budov. Máte alespoň 5 let relevantních pracovních zkušeností. Máte přímou praktickou zkušenost s prováděním technických auditů nemovitostí (Technical Due Diligence), například v souvislosti s jejich akvizicí, prodejem, pronájmem nebo financováním. Dokážete samostatně posoudit technický stav budovy, identifikovat stavební závady a technická rizika a navrhnout vhodná nápravná opatření. Orientujete se ve stavebních konstrukcích, českých stavebních předpisech, povolovacích procesech a požární bezpečnosti. Plynule komunikujete anglicky, a to slovem i písmem. Dokážete připravovat srozumitelné odborné zprávy a technickou dokumentaci v angličtině. Umíte samostatně analyzovat technické problémy, vyhodnocovat rizika a formulovat odborné závěry. Jste pečliví, dobře organizovaní a zvládáte pracovat na více projektech současně, často s krátkými termíny. Dokážete jasně komunikovat své závěry, obhájit odborný názor a jednat s klienty i dalšími účastníky projektu. Ovládáte MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Máte řidičský průkaz skupiny B a jste ochotni cestovat podle potřeb projektů. Další informace Co nabízíme? Zajímavou finanční odměnu Práci v úspěšné mezinárodní společnosti Vedení zajímavých projektů pro nadnárodní firmy Plný úvazek s flexibilní pracovní dobou a možností home office - záleží nám na dodržení termínů a kvalitě výsledku, ne na tom, jestli jsi v kanceláři od 9 do 17 Skvěle fungující a soudržný tým, který tě vždycky podpoří a ocení tvoje úspěchy Zázemí moderních kanceláří v centru Prahy včetně všech výhod s tím spojených Celofiremní akce a k tomu ještě navíc 3x do roka sportovně laděné nezapomenutelné teambuildingy Standardem je pět týdnů dovolené, příspěvek na stravování formou stravenkového paušálu (100 Kč /den), 2 dny zdravotního volna, narozeninové volno, volno na dobročinné účely, příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, Multisport karta, jazykové kurzy, finanční odměna za doporučení kolegy, neomezené množství výborné kávy, notebook, mobilní telefon a v neposlední řadě u nás podporujeme kariérní růst - nabízíme pestrý školící program, který je k dispozici všem Naši zaměstnanci sdílejí naši vizi a poslání. Nabízíme inspirativní pracovní prostředí, kde má každý příležitost přispět svými nápady a ovlivňovat pozitivní změny. Chceme, aby naši zaměstnanci byli úspěšní nejen v práci, ale i v osobním životě. Proto podporujeme zdravé, produktivní a flexibilní pracovní prostředí, které respektuje rovnováhu mezi pracovním a soukromým životem. Společnost Turner & Townsend je zaměstnavatelem poskytujícím rovné příležitosti. Vážíme si rozmanitosti a zavazujeme se vytvářet inkluzivní pracovní prostředí pro všechny zaměstnance. Aktivně podporujeme uchazeče ze všech prostředí a komunit. Více informací o naší společnosti naleznete na: www.turnerandtownsend.com Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects: Twitter Instagram LinkedIn _It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time._ Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorised Recruitment Agency/Search Firm for Turner & Townsend, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by the Recruitment Team, to submit candidates for review.

items.title: P2P Regional Operations - Africa
items.summary: About Us Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance. Â Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Â Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. About the Role As part of the Bybit Fiat team, we are looking for a P2P Regional Operations Manager to own regional growth strategy and day-to-day operational performance in Africa. You will lead a small team of regional Business Development specialists, partner closely with local teams on the ground, and serve as the regional growth engine to accommodate global P2P strategy, develop localised strategy and turn the strategy into execution. Â Reporting to the Global P2P Operations & COE Lead, you will be accountable for P2P regional growth target, merchant ecosystem development, regional product rollouts, and cross-functional coordination across Product, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Community, and Customer Service. This is a regional team leader role for someone who is equally comfortable in strategy thinking and solid market-level execution. Key Responsibilities Regional Operational Ownership â¢ Own day-to-day P2P business performance across Africa markets and other assigned regions. â¢ Monitor regional OKR including transaction volume, competitiveness, disputes, and fraud patterns, etc. â¢ Identify operational bottlenecks and propose data-driven solutions to improve platform efficiency and user experience. â¢ Provide localised business insights to the P2P Ops Lead, own regional strategy and contribute to product roadmap. Team Leadership â¢ Lead, coach, and develop a small team of regional Business Development managers covering target markets. â¢ Set clear targets, structured workflows, and review cadences for the BD team. â¢ Identify capability gaps and actively drive upskilling, hiring, and team development. â¢ Foster a performance-driven, collaborative, and ownership-led culture. Merchant Ecosystem Development â¢ Drive merchant onboarding, relationship management, performance tracking, incentive programs, and quality improvements across the region. â¢ Oversee and grow merchant community to maintain a healthy, active, and engaged P2P ecosystem. â¢ Serve as the primary liaison between Bybit and the regional merchant community. Cross-functional & Local Coordination â¢ Coordinate with local market teams to align operations with country-specific dynamics, regulations, and user behavior. â¢ Work with Product to communicate regional needs, test new P2P features, and support local rollout. â¢ Work with Risk and Compliance to ensure safe P2P operations (fraud prevention) and adherence to local regulatory requirements. â¢ Collaborate with Marketing and Community on regional campaigns and user education. â¢ Coordinate with Customer Service to support dispute resolution and ensure efficient handling of user cases. â¢ Execute and continuously contribute operational SOPs, working with P2P COE. Market Insights & Growth â¢ Analyze regional P2P market trends, pricing dynamics, payment methods, and competitive landscape. â¢ Surface insights from market research and merchant feedback to Product, Risk, Compliance, and CS, working with COE â¢ Lead regional P2P go-to-market initiatives and growth campaigns in partnership with Marketing. â¢ Drive execution of user acquisition initiatives and campaign rollouts What We're Looking For Must Have â¢ 5+ years of relevant experience in operations, business development, or product operations â ideally in crypto, fintech, tech., marketplaces, or adjacent sectors. â¢ 2+ years of proven experience leading or coordinating small teams. â¢ Hands-on experience operating across multiple countries or markets. â¢ Strong understanding of operational workflows, project management best practices, and structured execution. â¢ Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills â¢ Strategic thinking and analytical mindset: comfortable with dashboards, data-driven decision-making, and translating numbers into strategy and actions. â¢ Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a strong plus. â¢ Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving environment. Nice to Have â¢ Direct experience with P2P platforms, crypto exchanges, or digital asset ecosystems. â¢ Familiarity with merchant management in a marketplace or P2P environment. â¢ Exposure to risk monitoring, anti-fraud methods, KYC/KYB processes, or transaction oversight. â¢ Experience with growth campaigns, user acquisition, or market launches. â¢ Passion for blockchain, financial inclusion, and the future of decentralized finance. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. Please mention the word **HEARTILY** and tag RNTcuMTU2LjcwLjQ5 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTcuMTU2LjcwLjQ5). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. About the Role: Our QA-Core team exists so every engineering team at Upgrade can test their software quickly and trust the result. We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer on the team to architect and build test automation infrastructure, tooling, and agentic solutions to increase engineering productivity. This is not a traditional product QA role - it’s a build role. You will work closely with our product teams to understand their automation requirements, design services from scratch, ship them to production clusters and own them. This is a fully remote position open to candidates who are based in the US. Our Core Technologies Include: Java, Python, Kubernetes, Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, Grafana, SumoLogic, Docker, Gatling, Claude Code, MCP server What You’ll Do: Design and own automation framework for functional and performance testing. Build agents to automate existing QA/testing workflows and remove engineering friction. Build the applications and services that automation depends on, deploy them, and operate them in production environments. Take prototypes all the way. Build demos in a timely manner, gather feedback from the teams who'd use it, and iterate through successive versions until it's hardened, monitored, and running with matured quality. Identify gap areas in existing frameworks and tools, and iterate toward solutions that close them. What We Look For: 5-7+ years building production software, with demonstrated depth across test infrastructure, test frameworks, and developer tooling, and working knowledge of platform engineering. Proven track record building agentic solutions and test automation frameworks from the ground up — designed, shipped, iterated on, and adopted as part of how other engineers work. Fluency with agentic coding tools as part of your daily workflow: ability to orchestrate multiple agents to execute, review agent-generated PRs. Hands-on experience with micro-services, Kubernetes and managing deployment lifecycle Ability to take an ambiguous problem statement to a scoped, defensible solution independently. What We Offer You: Competitive salary and stock option plan Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-senior-qa-automation-engineer-platform

We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're r
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: https://oscarhealth.com Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics to join our Actuarial team. Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family. About the role: The Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics leads financial analysis and provides actuarial insight to support Oscar's provider contracting and network strategy. You will own end-to-end financial evaluation of complex, high-impact provider negotiations and develops contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks to advance network affordability and performance. In close partnership with Network Strategy & Performance, Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams, the Senior Manager evaluates new network strategies, identifies financial risks and opportunities, and strengthens analytical methods and tools. You will translate complex analyses into clear recommendations and reporting, helping business and operational leaders make informed decisions about provider reimbursement and network initiatives. You will report into the Director, Actuarial. Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events. #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role in the states of California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington is: $163,944 - $215,176 per year. The base pay for this role in all other locations is: $147,549 - $193,658 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses. Responsibilities: Own end-to-end financial analysis for complex, high-impact provider negotiations, evaluating proposed reimbursement rates, contract terms, and alternative structures to inform negotiation strategy and decision-making. In collaboration with Network Strategy & Performance, provide recommendations and thought partnership based on financial analysis and actuarial principles related to new network strategies and initiatives. Develop and maintain contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks aligned with business objectives. Strengthen analytical methods and processes for evaluating provider contracts, establishing consistent modeling standards and partnering with Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams to improve tools, reporting, and analytical efficiency. Identify and quantify financial risks and affordability opportunities through analysis of provider reimbursement, utilization, medical cost trends, and competitive benchmarks; recommend actions to improve network financial performance. Develop and deliver detailed reports, presentations, and dashboards that distill complex network medical economics insights for internal stakeholders, project teams, and business unit leaders. Maintain strong working relationships with key business and operational leaders (e.g., Network, Market P&L, Payment Integrity, Claim Operations) to ensure analytic solutions meet their needs. Other duties as assigned. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in a STEM field, or 4 years commensurate experience. 7+ years of quantitative analysis in the healthcare industry. Proven experience in health insurance / payer analytics, with an understanding of medical claims data (e.g., CPT/HCPCS, ICD-10, DRGs) and standard healthcare industry data sources. Bonus points: Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. Strong process management skills, with experience streamlining workflows and driving operational efficiency. Experience translating between clinical, business, and analytic vocabularies. Familiarity with ACA-specific healthcare laws, regulations, and compliance requirements. Associate or Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (SOA), or on the track to become one. This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives. Pay Transparency: Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education, and experience. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements. Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts. Reasonable Accommodation: Oscar applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments. Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years. We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers. What You’ll Do: Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions Build the dashboards and success metrics other teams adopt, and use data to drive cross-functional buy-in Lead the team and work cross-functionally Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar What You’ll Bring: Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement Ability to operate autonomously, with strong communication skills, ruthless about scope without sacrificing quality, and humble The annual US salary range for this role is $ 168,000 - $225,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-senior-database-reliability-engineer-i-germany-austria-uk

items.description: Revolutionize Healthcare with AI-Driven capabilities Join a passionate team working across the entire product stack in healthcare and application development. Help Xealth scale health programs, enabling clinicians to integrate, prescribe, and monitor tools that drive patient actions and utilization. Who You Are We are seeking a product manager who takes full ownership of outcomes and is energized by hands-on execution. As the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for your product area, you will be accountable for results end to end, from identifying customer problems through delivery and measurement of impact. You will leverage AI-powered tools central to how you work, using them to prototype rapidly, analyze data independently, accelerate discovery, and contribute directly to building solutions alongside engineering. The ideal candidate does not see a rigid boundary between product management and development; you are as comfortable defining requirements as you are helping bring them to life. You thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly as you learn, and value delivering meaningful progress over perfecting plans. If you are a product leader who prefers building to observing, we encourage you to apply. The Role Xealth is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Wearable Health Insights to own our integration of wearable data, combined with EHR data to create insights that help patients and clinicians toward better outcomes and deliver better financial benefits for health systems. Xealth sits at a unique intersection of healthcare data: we have deep integration with Electronic Health Records (EHRs), access to patient-generated data from third-party apps, and rich engagement data from patient clicks and actions. Integrating consumer wearable data and the power of AI will take us to new capabilities to care for people. In this role, you will be the product visionary for how we use this data and leverage generative AI to drive meaningful actions. You will oversee our integration of wearable data both consumer facing and health system facing. Your mission is to bring next-generation AI capabilities to market that personalize and enhance these interactions for both patients and providers. What You’ll Own and Deliver Vision & Strategy: Own the roadmap for Xealth’s wearable solutions - transitioning from dashboards to AI-enabled insights and real time, data-driven interaction models. AI-First Development: Identify and bring to market new AI capabilities that leverage EHR, third-party app, and engagement data to improve patient outcomes and clinician efficiency. We expect you to be able to be able to use AI research, plan, build, design, revise entire product features. You will then work closely with engineering to bring those capabilities to production Customer Focused: You will work with our customer teams as well as external health system relationships that you either bring or develop. Clinical insights are key to success and you will be expected to continuously seek out external validation of our product development priorities. Data-Driven Iteration: Use, and advocate for, data to measure impact and iteratively improve the effectiveness of our tools. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with internal teams (engineering, customer success, partnerships) and external health system customers to launch and scale engagement tools. Mission Focus: Make a real, positive difference in other people’s lives by finding new and compelling ways to support patients and clinicians. The Expertise You’ll Bring Experience: 5-10+ years of experience in Product Management for web-based, SaaS, or healthcare technology offerings. Domain Expertise: Firm grasp on wearable technology including sensors, overall landscape, and their impact on wellness and healthcare. Generative AI Expertise: Conversant with generative AI technology such as prompt engineering and MCP; able to drive product development of gen-AI product capabilities and offerings. Technical Proficiency: Ability to meaningfully engage in design discussions with software developers and translate these into technical specifications. Agile Leadership: Extensive experience in Lean, Agile, or Scrum software development processes. Influencing Skills: Success as a cross-team influencer with a track record of managing expectations with both internal stakeholders and external enterprise customers. About Xealth Xealth created the leading digital health platform helping health systems deliver connected, personalized care at scale. Embedded in the EHR, it enables clinicians to prescribe, automate, and measure the impact of digital tools–including apps, services, and wearable data–within existing workflows. Now part of Samsung’s connected care vision, Xealth enhances decision-making, reduces friction, and supports enterprise-wide digital health strategies. Trusted by more than 500 hospitals and 70+ solution partners, Xealth provides a scalable foundation for delivering connected, personalized, and preventative care–empowering health systems to drive outcomes, engagement, and operational efficiency while advancing digital transformation. As a market-leading digital health platform recognized for excellence and culture, some of our recent accolades include: Newsweek’s World’s Best Digital Health Companies (2024-2026), consecutive Gold Digital Health Awards, and we were named a BuiltIn Best Place to Work for 2025 and 2026. Compensation and Benefits: Xealth offers a multi-tiered approach when constructing a highly competitive compensation package. The compensation package would include a base salary, and a comprehensive suite of benefits in the range of $160,000 - $190,000. Paid parental leave. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision policies. Xealth covers 100% of employee premiums. We also provide Employee Assistance Programs. Xealth provides your laptop and offers a home office stipend. Generous learning & development opportunities for you to grow your skills and career. 401k Match: Xealth offers a dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%. Flexible time off & 10 standardized holidays. $500 yearly fitness stipend to spend on staying active. Xealth is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. #LI-XSL

items.description: Job Description Role Title: Project Manager Department / Seat Name: PMO Job Type: W2; Full-Time; Remote Role Summary The Project Manager (PM) plays a critical role in ensuring successful delivery of RSI Security’s cybersecurity and compliance engagements. The PM will lead the coordination, execution, and tracking of multiple client projects from kickoff through final deliverables, ensuring alignment across internal teams and client stakeholders. This role bridges Sales, Technical Operations, and the Client Experience team to drive execution and reinforce client trust throughout the engagement lifecycle. Role Purpose The Project Manager at RSI Security is responsible for orchestrating the seamless execution of client-facing cybersecurity and compliance engagements. This role exists to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards of quality, while fostering trust and transparency with clients and internal teams. By aligning cross-functional efforts and driving operational discipline, the Project Manager plays a vital role in preserving client satisfaction, optimizing resource utilization, and reinforcing RSI Security’s reputation for excellence. Core Responsibilities Project Delivery & Execution Own end-to-end project delivery: scope, timeline, resource coordination, and risk mitigation Facilitate project kickoffs, weekly status calls, and closeout activities Monitor project performance using KPIs and internal dashboards Ensure documentation, deliverables, and milestones are completed on time and to quality standards Client Experience & Communication Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution Provide clear and proactive communication to manage expectations and enhance satisfaction Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on observed client needs Internal Collaboration Coordinate with assessors, consultants, and technical SMEs to ensure aligned project delivery Work closely with the Sales and CX teams on pre-engagement planning and post-project review Contribute to process improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing Compliance & Operational Rigor Ensure all activities comply with internal standards, client contracts, and industry best practices Maintain accurate records in project management tools (e.g., Monday.com, HubSpot) Support internal QA efforts and contribute to lessons-learned reviews Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years of project management experience delivering client-facing engagements in professional services, consulting, or IT/cybersecurity. Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of concurrent client projects from kickoff through closeout, including scope, timeline, hours budget, and risk. Working familiarity with at least one cybersecurity or compliance framework (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CMMC, FedRAMP) and how audit or assessment engagements are structured. Hands-on experience with a work management platform (Monday.com, Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar) and a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar), with disciplined record-keeping. Experience leading client kickoffs, weekly status calls, and escalations as the primary point of contact. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate technical assessors and SMEs alongside non-technical client stakeholders. Important Notice to Job Applicants and Recruitment Agencies Work Authorization & Visa Sponsorship RSI Security is currently unable to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, O-1, STEM OPT extensions, or Permanent Residency/Green Card sponsorship) for any position (except for our offshore contractor positions). All applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States on a full-time, ongoing basis without the need for current or future employer immigration sponsorship Unsolicited Agency & Staffing Submissions Policy RSI Security does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate submissions, or profiles from recruiters, placement services, or staffing agencies.
