items.summary: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority items.title: Customer Service Representative
items.summary: Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff! Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around! We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home. Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently. Why Choose ShyftOff? No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control. 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home. Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work. You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability. Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility. Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents The Role As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability. One of our newest programs include: Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around. What you'll do: Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground. Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support. What you'll do: Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution What Makes You a Fit (all programs) Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred What You'll Need (all programs) Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum) A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.summary: Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM) Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean.
items.description: Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM) Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean. Selected countries include: Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Mexico, Panama y Uruguay. Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities. Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data. Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards. Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration. Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices. Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations. Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding. Required Skills and Qualifications: Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date. Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later. Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols. Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration. Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture. Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively. Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection. Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration. Preferred Qualifications: Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines. Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling. Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications. Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week . Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding. Equipment Requirements Mobile: Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks. Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding. IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: Candidates who meet the project’s location and equipment requirements will be contacted soon to complete an identity verification process. Selected candidates should be able to complete this ID verification within 48 hours of being contacted. Successful verification is required before the contract can be issued for signature. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Job Title: E-commerce Simulation Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems.
items.description: Job Title: E-commerce Simulation Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Design and build synthetic, digital stores with realistic product assortments, pricing, and category structures. Generate, structure, and maintain comprehensive product catalogs, ensuring data quality, logical consistency, and real-world complexity. Develop diverse, authentic shopping scenarios and user prompts, simulating varied consumer intents, preferences, and challenging edge cases. Create evaluation rubrics and conduct rigorous QA to assess AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, and reasoning. Continuously analyze model performance, identify failure patterns, and refine data and scenarios for iterative improvement. Collaborate with AI and data science teams to translate e-commerce expertise into actionable training datasets and insights. Document processes, share findings, and help drive best practices in simulation-based AI training. Required Skills and Qualifications: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce operations, merchandising, or catalog management. Proven expertise in product catalog structuring, data normalization, and content creation for online stores. Experience with AI/LLM prompting, evaluation, or training is highly valued. Strong analytical thinking and a rigorous QA mindset; detail-oriented approach to scenario and data generation. Demonstrated understanding of consumer behavior and online shopping journeys. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts effectively. Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality, scalable datasets for AI model training. Preferred Qualifications: Past experience training AI models or working in simulation/data design roles. Knowledge of emerging trends in e-commerce, retail analytics, or digital merchandising. items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: United States URL: https://tastelabs.com/ About the company Taste Labs is building the data and infrastructure layer for taste. Our goal is to end AI slop. To make AI feel right, not just be correct. We raised $18.5M in seed co-led by Amplify and CRV, and most frontier labs are already customers. AI has nailed objective domains and can generate anything. The hard part left is judgement: what fits, what feels like you, what's actually GREAT. We're turning that into something measurable, starting with design. We do it on two sides: building the post-training data and RL environments that teach taste to frontier models, and the context and verification tools agents need to produce work that's more creative, more on-brand, more right. If that problem excites you, you'll like it here! About this role The TasteMakers community is at the core of what we do. Your role is to build the operating system, processing and check-ins for the community to run smooth. This is not a community management role, it's an ops one - you need to be a phenomenal operator who's great at turning things into machines, while being great with people. DAY TO DAY You analyze the end to end funnel weekly, pull metrics and flag risks or areas of concern You run onboarding meetings and training with experts, you build training materials and create the process around it You run reactivation campaigns, engaging experts that have dropped off or not been active. You'll schedule sessions, email campaigns chase stalls, move experts through different steps in the funnel, answer questions, and more You'll run "bridging": the between project touchpoints to keep experts engaged and warm, so that retention stays high. YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU: Are a doer, you know how to get stuff done. The goal is not just spotting problems, it's fixing them end to end. You need to be a true owner and not be afraid to get hands dirty. Are comfortable with ambiguity. We love process, but we won't always have answers for everything and need to start moving with imperfect information. You need to be comfortable navigating these scenarios while trying to bring structure. Are very organized, meticulous and detail oriented Love this mission and problem we're working on. This domain of "taste" and "design" is creative and subjective, and it's part of the fun of it. WHERE YOU MIGHT COME FROM: We are intentionally open. A handful of profiles match the shape of this work, none of which are obvious by title. Ops or production coordinators at design-first agencies, studios, or production companies Talent coordinators at agencies, casting operations, or fellowship and residency programs Marketplace or community ops at companies where supply quality mattered more than supply volume Program coordinators who ran cohorts, bootcamps, or apprenticeships end to end Ops generalists or EAs at fast companies who built the tracker everyone ended up using Freelance producers who have kept many-headed projects on schedule without authority OTHER NOTES: This is a contractor position, fully remote US or Global. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Culver City, California, United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/kZSiaRVHB45MDzQ7znFJSV/jobs-at-crazy-maple-studio Crazy Maple Studio is a fast-growing company based in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, focusing on mobile gaming, reading, and streaming. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. Crazy Maple Studio, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/crazy-maple-studio-ai-assisted-story-writer-1099-contract

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission . To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH. Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization. Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization. Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers. Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences. The Qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr , e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development. A solid network within the Bundeswehr and a deep understanding of its organization, decision-making and budget and planning processes (e.g. the procurement process CPM). First-hand understanding of the process and data challenges in areas such as logistics, materiel readiness, maintenance or procurement. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and English. Familiarity with defense procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-defense-bundeswehr

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Albania URL: http://pavago.co Description SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. Interview Process Initial Application Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview Recruiter Screening Client Interview Final Selection & Onboarding Spark Hire Video Interview – Required As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire . After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses. Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation. Apply Now If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you. Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results. #SEOSpecialist #DigitalMarketing #TechnicalSEO #GoogleAds #PerformanceMarketing #LeadGeneration #AEO #GEO #MarketingAutomation #RemoteMarketingJobs #RemoteJobs #LI-AG1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pavago-seo-digital-marketing-specialist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: CINEMATIC VIDEO EDITOR – REAL ESTATE & CONSTRUCTION Salary range: up to Php 88,000 Philippine Peso/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.) Working Hours: Monday to Friday following New Zealand business time Work set-up: 100% Remote work (Independent Contractor Agreement) Holidays: TBC Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and assessment About the Company & Role Our client is a creative media production company specialising in producing professional visual content for businesses within the property, building, and construction sectors. The company provides a range of creative services, including photography, videography, aerial footage, and digital content production, helping businesses showcase their properties, projects, and services through compelling visual presentations. They are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Video Editor who can transform raw footage into polished, cinematic, and engaging video content that captures the quality and appeal of each project. The role involves editing various types of footage, including property walkthroughs, architectural spaces, construction developments, and commercial project showcases, while maintaining a consistent and professional visual style. The successful candidate will be expected to produce approximately 2–3 completed videos daily, balancing creative execution, technical quality, and production efficiency. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced editor who enjoys visual storytelling, understands cinematic editing techniques, and can deliver high-quality content in a fast-paced creative environment. Key Responsibilities Video Editing & Post-Production Edit raw video footage into professional, engaging, and cinematic video productions. Produce approximately 2–3 completed videos per day while maintaining consistent quality and creative standards. Create property walkthroughs, real estate promotional videos, architectural showcases, and construction project features. Apply professional editing techniques, including sequencing, transitions, pacing, music integration, and visual storytelling. Perform colour correction and colour grading to achieve a polished and consistent cinematic look. Edit and incorporate drone footage, interior and exterior shots, and other visual assets into cohesive video presentations. Adapt editing styles based on project requirements, target audiences, and creative direction. AI-Assisted Editing & Content Production Utilise AI-powered video editing and enhancement tools, particularly Higgsfield, to improve production workflows and creative output. Apply AI-assisted effects, enhancements, and visual elements while ensuring the authenticity and quality of the final content. Produce videos in different formats and aspect ratios, including landscape and vertical formats for various digital platforms. Optimise video content for online marketing and social media distribution. Ensure proper audio synchronisation, sound quality, captions, and overall video presentation. Quality Control & Project Management Review all completed videos to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional production standards before delivery. Manage multiple editing assignments and consistently meet daily production targets and deadlines. Maintain organised project files, raw footage, editing assets, and completed outputs. Implement feedback and revision requests promptly while maintaining attention to detail. Identify opportunities to improve editing workflows, turnaround times, and production efficiency. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Maintain consistency with the company's established creative direction and visual standards. Contribute creative ideas and recommendations to enhance the quality and impact of video content. Adjust editing approaches based on project requirements and client expectations. Collaborate with the team to ensure timely delivery and alignment with production objectives. Qualifications & Requirements Essential Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in video editing or post-production. Advanced proficiency in Final Cut Pro. Must have access to a Mac computer capable of running Final Cut Pro. Strong understanding of cinematic editing, storytelling, transitions, and video composition. Demonstrated experience in colour correction and professional colour grading. Proficiency in AI-powered video production tools, particularly Higgsfield. Strong understanding of audio synchronisation, sound design, music integration, and visual aesthetics. Ability to consistently deliver 2–3 completed videos per day without compromising quality. Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently in a deadline-driven environment. Must provide at least three (3) samples of previously produced landscape videos demonstrating editing skills and creative capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience editing real estate, property marketing, architectural, or construction-related videos. Experience incorporating drone footage into professional video productions. Knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, and visual effects. Familiarity with other AI-assisted video editing and content creation tools. Experience working with real estate professionals, property developers, builders, contractors, or commercial clients. Understanding of social media video formats and digital content requirements. Required Tools & Software Final Cut Pro: Advanced video editing and post-production. Higgsfield: AI-assisted video production, enhancement, and creative effects. Colour Grading Tools: Professional colour correction and grading capabilities. Audio Editing Tools: Sound design, audio synchronisation, and music integration. Video Exporting Tools: Experience preparing videos in landscape and vertical formats. Skills & Competencies Creative Storytelling: Ability to transform raw footage into visually compelling narratives. Strong Visual Aesthetic: Excellent eye for composition, lighting, colour, and pacing. Time Management: Capable of handling multiple projects and meeting daily production targets. Adaptability: Can work across different video styles and project requirements. Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy and consistency in every finished video. Coachability: Receptive to feedback and willing to make revisions when necessary. Reliability: Demonstrates accountability, effective communication, and consistency in delivering quality work. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://usserviceanimals.org Sales Consultant – (Uncapped Bonuses) Remote · Full-time · $19.00/hr base + uncapped bi-weekly bonuses, 40 hours weekly within 8 AM–9 PM CST Tired of a paycheck that’s the same no matter how hard you work? Good. So are we. Intellipet helps dog owners get the training their dogs need: in-home sessions with professional trainers, virtual coaching, and programs for everyday manners up to service-dog work. People call us because something isn’t working at home, and they need someone to help them fix it. That’s you. This job is for you if: You’re motivated by money and you’re not shy about it. Bonus weeks get you out of bed. You like people and want them to leave the call better off than they started. You can hear “I need to think about it” and know how to keep a conversation going. You want a job where effort shows up in your paycheck. This job is NOT for you if you’re looking to clock in, take calls and clock out. Base Pay is how you pay the bills, BONUS is how you LIVE! What you’ll do: Talk with dog owners who reached out for help (warm inbound and follow-up leads, no cold calling). Learn their dog, their home and their goals, then match them to the right training program. Close the sale, handle objections, and set firm follow-ups. Hit weekly targets and watch your bonuses stack. What you get: $19.00/hr base pay , so you’re never at zero. Uncapped weekly bonuses. items.description: The Role As the Director of B2B Media Strategy at Wpromote, you’ll help enterprise and high-growth clients turn complex business goals into measurable marketing success. You’ll work closely with channel experts, client services, and analytics teams while collaborating directly with client-side sales and marketing leaders. This role is ideal for someone with deep B2B expertise, strong executive presence, and the ability to turn strategic vision into hands-on execution in a fast-paced, competitive space. Leading cross-channel media efforts across Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic (Display, Video, OTT, Audio, DOOH), SEO, content syndication, and PR. Optimizing media mix, budget allocation, audience segmentation, creative alignment, and measurement plans tied to full-funnel performance—not just top-of-funnel KPIs. Developing advanced audience strategies using ABM platforms (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense) and CRM/marketing automation data for precision targeting. Championing continuous improvement through structured testing frameworks to validate messaging, audience targeting, and channel mix. Partnering with creative teams to align messaging to B2B buyer journeys, industry verticals, and decision-maker personas. Leading and collaborating with Wpromote’s internal channel teams to align and execute integrated, high-impact strategies. Partnering with Client Services to develop frameworks for business reviews, leading the storytelling of cross-channel insights Providing client and industry-specific thought leadership Driving strategic ideation and innovation across your clients and within the organization, facilitating new channel exploration and new partner RFPs Operational Consulting & Design Conducting operational assessments using maturity maps, resource planning models, and digital transformation frameworks to identify gaps and opportunities. Advising on martech, adtech, and datatech architecture to ensure optimal integration, efficiency, and ROI. Aligning sales and marketing strategies, processes, and KPIs to optimize impression-to-revenue velocity. Ensuring audience segmentation and messaging alignment that accelerates pipeline movement and deal conversion. Leading client performance reviews that combine media insights with operational recommendations, translating results into actionable next steps. Serving as a trusted advisor who can bridge campaign-level execution with strategic operational transformation. Practitioner-level working knowledge of: Analytics tools: GA4, Adobe Analytics Tagging & tracking: Google Tag Manager (GTM) or equivalent Ad platforms: DSPs (The Trade Desk, DV360), LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other social ad platforms SEO/content tools: SEMrush, Ahrefs, or equivalent Expertise in audience segmentation, creative alignment, and measurement planning using ABM platforms (Demandbase, 6sense) and intent data sources (Bombora, G2, LinkedIn). Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data, identify opportunities, and make in-flight optimizations. Operational Consulting & Design Skills Deep working knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics) and marketing automation platforms (Marketo, Pardot, HubSpot Marketing Hub), including hands-on configuration, workflow creation, and reporting. Experience deploying operational solutions in CRM/MAP systems—such as lead routing, lifecycle stage definitions, scoring models, attribution setup, and dashboard creation. Familiarity with sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft) and sales intelligence tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo). Proven ability to assess and improve sales and marketing alignment using structured frameworks like maturity maps, resource planning models, and digital transformation roadmaps. Experience integrating martech, adtech, and datatech platforms to create scalable go-to-market systems. Ability to manage and execute cross-functional projects involving sales, marketing, and technical teams. Strong knowledge on best-in-class B2B measurement models including MTA, MMM and other advanced marketing analytics methodologies. Nice to Have Experience in B2B SEO and content syndication strategy. PR and earned media strategy experience within a B2B context. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Montreal, Quebec, Canada URL: https://www.sweatpantsagency.com/ Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end. Here is what "end to end" actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme. You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number. You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output. If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast. If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading. Requirements What the job looks like Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month. Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working. Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people. Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing. Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target. Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule. Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery. Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why. Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team. Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt. You are a fit if You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search. You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have. You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard. You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you. Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too. You are not a fit if "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed. You want to be told what to do this week. You need a ticketing system to know what matters. You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question. Benefits Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweat-pants-agency-ppc-marketing-specialist-remote
